citations.assessment: The Abba dossier identifies the variant in Tanchuma Re’eh and makes the Iva/Abba identification tentative.
The Tanchuma passage names Iva bar Kahana in the teaching on blessing and measurement. The pointer does not settle whether he is Abba bar Kahana.
